statement: A smooth canonical sextic obtained by intersecting a smooth quadric and a smooth cubic in projective 3-space over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two has 120 tritangent planes. The proof establishes a bijection with odd theta characteristics; each is represented by its contact divisor.

notes:
A smooth quadric is required for this version of the statement. Contact-divisor interpretation allows appropriate special contacts; generic curves have distinct contact points.
